_meta.com.requstory/summary: Send a buyer's quote request to a supplier in the Index; the buyer confirms by email, then the supplier replies by email.

annotations.title: Request a quote from a supplier

description: Send a quote request to one supplier from search_suppliers on behalf of a buyer: what they need, how many and where to deliver. The supplier gets it by email and replies to the buyer directly; nothing is ordered or paid. Use only with the buyer's consent to share their name and email with that supplier. Returns the request number, the supplier and status "confirm": Requstory emails the buyer a link, and the request goes to the supplier once the buyer clicks it. "next" says this in words to pass on to the buyer.

buyerEmail.description: The buyer's email, where the supplier replies. Use it only with the buyer's consent.

deliverTo.description: Where to deliver: town or postcode and country.

items.description: What the buyer needs: products, sizes, specifications.

message.description: Anything else for the supplier, such as a delivery date.

quantity.description: How many, e.g. "5,000 cups a month".

supplier.description: The "supplier" value from search_suppliers (the supplier's website domain).

name: request_quote

next.description: What happens next, in words to pass on to the buyer.

status.description: "confirm": waiting for the buyer to click the link Requstory emailed them; then it goes to the supplier.
